settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Shipping times vary by destination and product. Check the shipping details shown at checkout and our shipping policy for current information.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: When tracking is available, you’ll receive shipment information using the contact details provided with your order.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel an order?
settings.answer: Contact us as quickly as possible. We’ll help when an order has not already entered fulfillment.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Return eligibility and timing are described in the store’s current refund policy. Please review that policy before starting a return.

settings.question: What if my item arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Contact customer support with your order information and photos of the issue so we can review what happened.

settings.question: Do you sell products for both dogs and cats?
settings.answer: Yes. Paws & Claws is designed around everyday favorites and essentials for both dogs and cats.

settings.question: How do I know which size to order?
settings.answer: Use the size information shown on the product page when available and measure your pet before ordering wearable items.

settings.question: Do you offer discounts or promotions?
settings.answer: Promotions may be offered from time to time. Join the Paws & Claws newsletter for store updates and special offers.
